text_block_list.text:
I've done everything I can... This race is
mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
O-of course I am! How am I supposed to
win if I
don't focus?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... We worked so hard together for
this day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'll run my best. I'm not afraid of the
crowd, or
the competition!
